title: Neighbourhood water pump
description: Residents and a coordinator report a broken pump. Made-up data.

events.speaker: resident-a
events.text: The water pump on Elm Street stopped working this morning.

events.speaker: resident-b
events.text: I heard a grinding noise from the pump last night.

events.speaker: coordinator
events.text: Thanks both. A mechanic will inspect the pump on Thursday.

events.speaker: coordinator
events.name: pump-inspection.txt
events.text: Inspection report, Elm Street pump. The bearing is worn and the seal leaks. Replace both. Expected cost 340 euro. The pump is safe to leave switched off until then.

events.speaker: resident-c
events.text: My phone number for the mechanic is 06 0000 0000, please remove it afterwards.

events.speaker: coordinator
events.text: The temporary code for the pump house is 4471.

events.speaker: coordinator
events.text: The repair is planned for next Monday. The street stays open.
